bookAvailabilityAudit.delayAnchor: Additional latency after our first observation, NOT latency measured from publication or source fill
bookAvailabilityAudit.rule: First stored L2 with observedAt>=firstObservation+delay, quote age[-1,10]seconds at receipt, nonemptybid/ask and overshoot<=10seconds. Availability only; quantity/depth/cash/venue/gates not re-simulated. Later observations kept as unavailable at target, never interpolated. Same rule fixed before examining prices/results.
bookAvailabilityAudit.representativeness: Fixed descriptive window includes only observed events; book markets are selected by actual collection needs, so availability may be conditioned on live activity. This is not an unbiased market-wide replay feed.

nextTest: Trace saved L2 gaps around source-poll and reconciliation phases to identify timing bottlenecks; do not widen tolerance or report latency P&L from unequal availability subsets.
